title: A CI status line never calls a draft run or a run with skipped required jobs green
why: A reader trusts the green line and merges an untested head; the merge tool's own checks should still refuse.
source: coordinator 12:16 CST Nov 12, from batch runner 10 at 12:15 CST on #2814
note: A PostToolUse hook on update_pull_request printed "CI green on d783a41: no failing jobs" when the only run on that head was the draft run (27 jobs skipped, 1 success); the ready run had not started. Fix: a run whose required jobs were skipped, or a draft run, never reads green; say "no ready run yet". Red first. Lane started 12:16 CST, before this step was filed (coordinator pick, page item 585).
